tools_used: engine web fetch (supremecourt.gov PDF) + pypdf text extraction
helpful: The frozen band plus the sal-v4 per-Term reached rates made the anchor mechanical
Full-text petition and Guild BIO with no empty_text; the QP file was cleanly cut
Snapshot docket entries carry the supremecourt.gov PDF URLs, which made fetching the unprovisioned federal BIO a one-step retrieval
gaps: The document pipeline provisions one brief-in-opposition per docket; on dockets with a federal and a private respondent the SG's brief was the one dropped
fedcourts query has no case-name or party filter, so finding NLRB priors meant pulling 100-row disposition slices and filtering locally on case_name
CourtListener's SCOTUS docket search returned nothing for a current-Term docket number (25-627), so related-petition outcomes had to come from the parties' briefs
No as-at-prediction relist hazard is published; the relist-increment claim is anchored on terminal buckets
notes: The query rows' caption field is `case_name`, not `caption`; a note in docs/cli.md would save a wasted first pass.
